steel_albedo.webp.processing: WebP quality 0.50 from original provider; no resize or color-space transform.

steel_arm.webp.role: Linear red occlusion, green roughness, blue metallic
steel_arm.webp.processing: Lossless WebP repack of the prepared PNG; exact decoded pixels, same dimensions and channel order.

steel_normal_gl.webp.processing: Lossless WebP repack of the prepared PNG; exact decoded pixels, same dimensions and channel order.

preparation.normal_exr_variant: Original TinyEXR rejection preserved externally; the PNG source representation is used instead.
preparation.data_map_repack: Exact decoded pixel equality against the prepared PNGs; no second resize or channel transform.
preparation.budget_choice: The measured quality-0.70 alternative left only 335 source bytes after composition with current main. The quality-0.50 alternative preserves resolution and the existing error bound while leaving room for the pending press-clearance fix.

runtime: Mipmaps generated once, with normal renormalization. World-space triplanar scale 0.5 maps the source over two metres. No displacement geometry is applied.
limits: Source data and image tests do not establish rendered quality or GPU cost.
